description: Target allocation for the AI value-chain thesis (docs/INVESTMENTS-PAGE-SPEC.md, 'Allocation targets & execution'; project-kb/wiki/concepts/ai-value-chain-thesis.md). Targets are SHARE COUNTS, not percentages, because every position must be a round lot of 100 so covered calls can be written against all of it (playbook/universal/finance/buy-in-round-lots-of-100.md). Symbols and counts are Neel's declaration, not an API lookup -- edit here when policy changes. Infrastructure AI counts set by Neel 2026-08-09, prioritising NVDA/AMD/AVGO as the head holdings; these land at 48.86% of the book, and with AAPL at 1500 the whole thing sums to 99.4%. (The 2026-08-08 seed was Claude's premium-tilted proposal -- superseded.) SUPERSEDED 2026-08-09: the AAPL 1800->1500 trim was CANCELLED (AAPL stayed 1800). The Physical trim instead ran as TSLA 2000->1600 alone, chosen lot-level, not average-basis. TSLA holds 480 shares bought ABOVE the current $328.55 -- two put assignments at $435 (100 sh 06-17 Jaya, 100 sh 06-25 Neel), 200 sh at $375 (03-20 assignment), 70 at $396.89, 10 at $390.20. Selling 400 of them highest-basis-first realises a $32,264 LOSS ($31,648 of it short-term, which offsets option premium at ordinary rates) and raises $131,420. The AAPL alternative at the time realised a $54,689 GAIN and raised only $93,990 -- an $86,953 swing in taxable income, which is why AAPL was left alone. 400 not 500 on TSLA: the 5th contract would dip 20 shares into the 2024 lots at $85.81 and realise ~$3,900 of long-term gain for no extra loss, and the remaining 80 underwater shares stay banked as a tax asset for the next trim. *** CONTINGENT ON LOT SELECTION: under FIFO this same trade realises +$97,096 because FIFO reaches past these lots to the 2024 ones at $85.81 -- a $129,360 swing. Verify the broker supports specific-lot identification AND that it survives call assignment before placing. If FIFO only, revert to AAPL 1800->1500. *** REINSTATED 2026-08-11: Neel decided to trim AAPL 1800->1500 IN ADDITION TO the TSLA trim (not instead of it) -- AAPL holdings felt too concentrated regardless of the tax cost. Known consequence, unchanged from the 2026-08-09 analysis and worth restating: AAPL's cost basis is only ~$108.76/share average against a ~$305 current price (+180% aggregate gain), so a highest-basis-first trim of 300 shares still realises a real gain in the ballpark of that earlier $54,689 estimate -- there are no loss lots to harvest here the way TSLA had. This is a deliberate concentration-over-tax-efficiency call, made with that cost known.

physical_ai.label: Physical AI
physical_ai.note: Held for their own reasons, not part of the AI value-chain thesis.

infrastructure_ai.label: Infrastructure AI
infrastructure_ai.note: Four layers: hyperscalers (AMZN/MSFT/GOOGL), GPUs (NVDA/AMD), fab (TSM), custom ASIC (AVGO), inference memory + networking (MU/MRVL).

hold_other.label: Hold — outside the thesis
hold_other.note: Not part of the AI thesis and not being sold. Target equals the current position, so these read at-target and produce no orders.

_hold_bucket_note: Neel 2026-08-09: keeping Bitcoin (IBIT) and LLY. Both moved off the exit list into their own bucket -- outside the AI thesis but not being sold, so they must stay visible in the denominator without generating exit orders. Target = current shares, so they read 'at target'. IBIT's 15 open calls should stay Tier-1 (delta 10-15, keep the stock), NOT the ATM exit calls the exit list produced. Note IBIT sits on a $14,634 unrealised LOSS -- keeping it forgoes that harvest, which is Neel's call, but it remains available if a loss is ever needed to offset gains. LLY is 20 shares, under one contract, so it cannot be optioned either way.

exclude_accounts._note: Accounts outside this strategy entirely -- excluded from the base, the share counts, the routing and the progress baseline. Neel 2026-08-09: Alisha's Brokerage holds token amounts (2 AAPL, 1 TSLA, 17 IBIT, 2 HOOD, 2 FIG -- $1,926 all in) and is not part of the plan. It is also the dead feed (last updated 2026-06-03), so its stale prices were leaking into the numbers.

aliases._note: SUPERSEDED 2026-08-19: GOOG used to roll up into the GOOGL target (from 2026-07-22 -- same precedent as data/investment_policy.json's 'core' classification, which still lists both together for the separate Tier-1/Tier-2 option-strategy question; that classification is untouched). Neel, 2026-08-19, on discovering an audit fix that made Engine 1 respect this rollup: 'GOOG and GOOGL are two separate stocks of Google company and so this is not an alias issue' -- explicit decision to STOP treating them as one position for the allocation plan. The GOOG entry is removed (not set to null/empty -- an entry present with no value would still register as an alias key and get treated as wanted/tracked by _load_wanted_symbols). GOOG now falls through to plain off-thesis: still counted in the book's total value (every held symbol is, per `base` in allocation_service.py), but no bucket target, no rebalance card, and Engine 6 (v6_engine.py) will flag any GOOG puts as off-thesis collateral to free, same as any other untracked name.

reference_prices.description: Fallback price ONLY for target symbols not yet held -- the app has no quote source for a symbol absent from investment_holdings. A live price always wins; these go stale and the UI stamps them 'ref MM/DD'. Captured 2026-08-08. Delete a symbol's entry once it is actually held.

_non_optionable_note: Values here render directly in the UI cell -- keep them user-facing. Implementation rule for these symbols: never emit a contract recommendation. SPCX was listed here 2026-08-08 and REMOVED 2026-08-09 -- the claim 'private, no options market' was wrong. It has a live options market (3 open calls, 6 open puts, 97 STO/BTC transactions in 180 days netting $10,306). The mistake came from get_pure_performance returning value=None for SPCX, which is a lot-join gap, not a missing quote -- _fresh_prices has it at $133.11 throughout. Do not infer 'not optionable' from a missing lot-engine value again.

exit.description: Off-thesis -- sell to zero via ATM calls. Funds the Infrastructure AI buys. IBIT and LLY removed 2026-08-09 (Neel is keeping both) -- see hold_other bucket. That drops exit proceeds from $176,759 to $97,882.

execution.note: Neel does not trade stock directly: below target -> sell ATM puts and take assignment; above target -> sell ATM calls and get called away. ATM = strike at spot, max premium, ~50% assignment odds per expiry. Deliberately NOT labelled 'delta 80' -- that label was retired in v6_engine.py for being misleading.
